head: 805c204a9dbfb5b8128de8f70c9f3fbd6d6583f9
rationale: The change adds a switch case right after one that had no break because it used to be last, so every guide that sets a priority also has its tile hidden. ocra reported it in all four runs on this pull request, and an AACR-Bench reference names the missing break.

expect.concern: The priority case has no break, so it falls through into the new tileVisible case: a guide that sets priority also calls setTileVisible(Boolean.parseBoolean(null)), which is false, and its tile is hidden.
